rules.title: N+1 IO or query pattern
rules.description: A database, HTTP, or file call inside a loop over a collection that could be batched, prefetched, or joined.

rules.title: Blocking call in async path
rules.description: Sync-over-async (.Result, .Wait, getResult) or a blocking IO call on an async/hot path. Risks thread starvation and deadlocks.

rules.title: Avoidable allocation in hot loop
rules.description: Object/string/collection allocation inside a tight loop that can be hoisted, reused, or pooled.

rules.title: Unbounded growth
rules.description: Cache, list, or buffer that grows without eviction or limit — a slow memory leak under sustained load.

rules.title: Repeated expensive computation
rules.description: Identical expensive work (regex compile, reflection, parsing, serialization) recomputed per call instead of cached or hoisted.
